kind: analyze (screened 2D Poisson electrostatics from a staged charge field; no DFT, no structure build)
provenance: values from 3_reproduction/L8/result.json and compute_screened_potential.py (per-layer screened 2D Poisson solve of L7's piezocharge). Ground truth is OUR reproduction on the staged charge field; the paper's ~90/40 meV is the fidelity check, not the graded number. Paper magnitude comparison definition and fidelity disposition remain pending; verified task computation is not a full paper-fidelity pass.
staged_input: agent/piezocharge.csv is a cleaned local copy of the consumed L7 field.
convention_note: The absolute sign of V^RP is convention-soft (the staged bound charge is defined up to an overall sign). The graded quantities are sign-robust: peak-to-peak amplitudes, the layer ratio, the per-locale MAGNITUDES, the extremum locale (argmax magnitude), and the sign-CONTRAST topology (products), all invariant under a global sign flip. The all-atom (nearest-locale mean) binning is graded because the prompt asks for the mean over all sites of each locale (the natural binning from the staged locale column).

ratio_pp_WS2_over_WSe2.rule: within 10% of the true value (band 1.997-2.441); sign-free, scale-free relative-layer check

profile_magnitude.rule: The per-locale |V^RP| profile is graded as one curve, matched point-by-point; tol_i = max(0.10*|truth_i|, floor), floor = 0.10*max = 3.789 meV. Sign-robust (magnitudes).

extremum_locale.rule: The largest absolute locale mean is at R^M_h in both layers. This checks the three submitted means, not the location of extrema in the full spatial field.

sign_topology.rule: sign-CONTRAST, invariant under a global flip: within each layer V^RP(R^X_h) and V^RP(R^M_h) have opposite sign; across layers V^RP_WS2(R^M_h) and V^RP_WSe2(R^M_h) have opposite sign. Evaluated on the agent's OWN submitted values (products < 0).

score: 1 only if all four groups pass (all checks must pass; any single failure scores 0): (a) the three scalars, (b) the 6-point magnitude profile, (c) the extremum locale R^M_h in both layers, (d) the three sign-contrast relations.

self_check_2026-06-22.direction1_our_reproduction_as_submissio: score 1 (raw-sign and physics-pinned-sign submissions both pass; sign-robust)
designed_wrong_must_fail: all |V^RP| reported as positive (no contrast) -> sign_topology fails
WS2/WSe2 pp swapped (ratio ~0.45) -> ratio + pp fail
extremum reported at R^X_h (R^X_h mean larger than R^M_h) -> extremum_locale fails
paper amplitudes 90/40 instead of our 171/77 -> pp fail (self-consistent ground truth)
flat field (all locale means equal) -> profile + extremum + sign_topology fail

coverage_note: Magnitude profiles and the three listed RXh/RMh sign products are graded. Rhh signs and arithmetic consistency of the separately reference-graded submitted ratio are not additional conditions.
